description_uk: Розпашілий і знесилений, дрібно тремтить під бірюзовою ковдрою та притискає її до грудей. Термометр залишається біля рота, а важка голівка повільно хилиться.

semantics.core_scene: Feverish flushed cheeks, tired eyes, thermometer, folded turquoise blanket under navy cloak; gentle shiver/check of thermometer.
semantics.scene_specific_instructions: Feverish shiver, thermometer лишається в одному mouth/hand стані; blanket/lap контакт, shoulders trembling and eyelid/head exhaustion. Не робити handoff термометра.
authored_decisions: Thermometer remains in the same mouth state. Blanket/seat and two feet stay supported.
semantics.irreversible_motion_policy: Only coherent authored local action. No backward falling particles, liquid or free props. Decorative held marks remain explicitly decorative.

source_review: Every selected source PNG individually inspected at native512. Exact selected source indices/hashes are recorded above. Original84-frame before sequence remains available for independent QA.

candidate_visual_review.scope: Every final decoded frame inspected in ordered224px boards, plus9native512phase/loop images. Author review only; no native realtime/slowed/device perception claim.
candidate_visual_review.observation: Scene-specific gesture/props/contacts retained, no double-exposure contour or limb swap observed in this author scope; independent per-item QA required.

review_validation_scope: Actual copied target paths must pass shared freeze_guard synchronously before package publication. Source validation alone is insufficient.
